phase_prompt.label: Phase 1
phase_prompt.summary: Obsidian Codex in pristine condition, glowing red glyphs, clear command logs.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A photorealistic close‑up of a thick slab of translucent black obsidian, its surface etched with ancient Ethiopian glyphs glowing in red, displaying scrolling command‑line logs. The slab sits on cracked desert ground, dust motes floating, cinematic lighting highlighting the tactile texture.
